versions.changelog: Self-check now takes document text through files or stdin instead of command-line arguments; the no-expansion rule is scoped so it no longer removes factual, risk or 口径 caveats; bundled script and language scope are now declared.
v1.0.2: English-only display name (SurgeonEdit), bilingual description with CN+EN triggers
v1.0.1: bilingual display name - 手术刀 (Chinese) / SurgeonEdit (English)

- Initial release of minimal-edit.
- Provides detailed rules and workflow for making minimal, tone-preserving edits to existing Chinese or English texts.
- Defines specific operation types: change viewpoint, delete, lower emphasis, fix fact or wording, de-AI tone, and composite requests.
- Emphasizes no explicit change markers, minimal formatting alteration, and strict length and scope control.
- Includes self-check/audit steps to ensure changes are minimal and targeted.
